column1: # Routes of the paper's proofs, for scripts/route_check.py: label, environment, whether the paper
# proves it, and the labels of the results that its proof cites.
# Written by hand from the published version (Bioinformatics 42, Supplement 1, btag245, 2026), which
# has no public TeX source. The labels are the identifiers of the statements and equations in the
# publisher's JATS XML (Europe PMC, PMC13340232): mthst2 = Lemma 1, mthst4 = Lemma 2 (its proof is
# mthst5), mthst9 = Theorem 1 (its proof is mthst10), E1-E5 = Equations (1)-(5).
# The proof of Lemma 1 ("This lemma follows directly from Observation 2 in Warnow et al. (2025)")
# cites only a result from prior work, and the proof of Lemma 2 cites nothing. The proof of
# Theorem 1 cites Lemma 1, Lemma 2, Equation (2) and Equations (4) and (5).
